Measurement setting matters.

The approved Xtrusio view has Prose mentions OFF. Turning it ON gives a 36.0% ten-scan average and a 22.9% latest scan. Keep the chosen setting fixed during review; neither mode is a recommendation rate.

Of 35 questions, 19 improved, 6 were flat and 10 declined. Nine of these ten also lost citation share; Q002’s citation share increased. Declining visibility does not mean complete citation loss.

Diagnosis: evidence and investigation

Issue What is known What we need to verify
Domain access A saved automated request returned www 403 and non-www 404; another reader retrieved the www page. Robots rules, WAF logs, redirects, canonicals and rendered content. This does not prove ChatGPT is blocked.
Content and page recovery Ten historical page rows lost citation share but remained cited. Buyer fit, approved capabilities, integration evidence and competitive answer gaps. Pages and questions are separate registers.
Channel variability Broader-account channel totals differ from the exact 35-question citation export. Three-month source use, recent changes and possible tracking/scoring issues.

The Google update, bot blocking and Reddit scoring are hypotheses, not confirmed causes. Sirion’s web team supplies access and logs; Xtrusio documents and verifies findings.

What success should look like

Aim for a 10–15% relative improvement in sustained visibility over six months. Lock scoring and review windows at kickoff. The wider 154-question report remains context, not this cohort’s denominator.

10–15%relative growth
over six months
Metric Xtrusio baseline Month 6 aim Profound baseline Month 6 aim
Sustained visibilitySeparate native baselines 56.0% 61.60–64.40% 45.3% 49.83–52.10%

Planning targets, not guaranteed results: baseline × 1.10–1.15, rounded to two decimals (not a 10–15 percentage-point increase). These are provisional objectives for each system, not predicted channel contributions. Freeze the 35-question cohort, mention setting and equivalent review windows; assess 30, 60 and 90 days, then month 6. Do not compare an expanding all-time baseline with a shorter follow-up window. Review rank, recommendations and citations separately.

Rectification plan

Workstream Deliverable Owner Validation
Crawler and domain readiness Audit priority URLs and both hostnames; provide a prioritised fix list. Xtrusio diagnoses; Sirion implements CMS, redirects and security. Before/after response evidence and canonical page identity.
Ten CBO page refreshes Month 1: six pages. Month 2: four pages and two supporting pieces. Xtrusio writes; Sirion validates claims and publishes. Answer inclusion, page citations and explicit recommendations.
Omnipresent content A monthly content system across website, third-party, LinkedIn, YouTube and Medium. Two dedicated resources, with named Sirion reviewers. Live URL, publication date, question mapping and observed citation.
Community and journalist coverage Karma-led Reddit participation under an approved engagement strategy; 10 tailored pitches monthly. Xtrusio manages; Sirion approves sensitive claims; editors decide. Submitted work, acceptance type and actual publication, separately tracked.
Monitoring and analytics 600 questions × 6 engines × 2 runs; preserve the exact 35-question target cohort. Xtrusio scans and reports; Sirion grants analytics access. Fixed-window visibility, citations, share of voice and referral traffic.

Page updates use existing website slots. Additional engineering, premium publishing and new external software commitments require separate approval.

Payment and execution

Approved publisher charge C
Xtrusio story development and coordination 15% × C
Total optional booster charge 1.15 × C

Example: $1,000 publisher fee + $150 execution fee = $1,150, before applicable taxes. If Sirion pays the publisher directly, our execution fee is billed separately.

Scope and account control

  1. Sirion approves the outlet, format, story and itemized quote.
  2. Sirion owns the account and can pay directly, or authorize Xtrusio to arrange payment.
  3. Xtrusio develops the additional story with the publisher and coordinates review.
  4. Publisher terms, sponsorship disclosure and editorial acceptance apply.

The 15% fee applies to approved publisher spend, not the $10,000 retainer. This booster is additional to the six existing third-party articles and the ten journalist pitches; it is not charged twice for work already included.

Start with confirmed opportunities. Annual packages are evaluated on their actual article allowance and terms, not just a low monthly equivalent. There is no committed outlet, spend, publication count or citation result until an appropriate package is approved.

Paid visibility does not guarantee ChatGPT citations, recommendation rank or referral traffic. Publisher fees, applicable taxes and the 15% execution fee are additional to the monthly program and require approval.

Commercial proposal

Retain the core content, monitoring, analytics and Reddit. Replace Quora with dedicated journalist outreach. The monthly offer remains $10,000.

Evidence, dates and measurement notes
  • Question match: all 35 question texts were reconciled across the saved Xtrusio records and Profound prompt exports. The answers, execution times and model configurations are not identical.
  • Xtrusio source: live Executive Summary, 35 baseline, ChatGPT, all 10 scans, Prose mentions OFF. Saved UI evidence: tmp/sirion-matched-2026-09-29/xtrusio-matched-duration-prose-off-dom.txt. Period average: 196/350; latest: 15/35. These are different measures.
  • Profound source: live Visibility, Pre-Sig, Full lifecycle, ChatGPT, No Persona, 23 April–28 September 2026 selected; native period score 45.3%, with 4,515 answers shown by the export control. Latest-day score 46.7% comes from the separate 28 September view. The export answer count is not assumed to be the native score denominator.
  • Question provenance: the 10 declining questions came from Profound’s 35-question ChatGPT export for 25 August–21 September 2026, with 980 executions. All 10 match this fixed cohort exactly. The proposal’s 10 page-refresh candidates are a separate citation-page list for that cohort, not a one-to-one question list.
  • Limits: question texts are identical, but answers, collection times, model configurations and scoring are not. Profound’s daily chart export was interrupted; same-scan-date trend alignment remains pending. The recalled 48.4% was not verified under the captured filters.

Authentic screenshots are included. The aim is a stronger recurring evidence base through website recovery and coordinated content distribution; this comparison does not prove that any channel causes a particular percentage uplift.
